revised_prompt: Create a detailed 16-bit pixel art illustration in a wide landscape composition, approximately 16:9. Crisp hard pixel edges, carefully crafted retro game pixel clusters, no smooth vector edges, no antialiasing or blur. Warm muted retro palette of teal, warm grey, navy, cream, with orange accents; absolutely no purple neon. Funny satirical editorial news-illustration mood. Scene: the exhausted late-night atmosphere of a casino-style card room at 2am, conveyed through dark blue windows, sleepy faces, dim warm lamps, and coffee cups WITHOUT clocks or written time. A group of hoodie-wearing open-source developers on the left and foreground are energetically flipping a big teal-felt poker table upward, legs lifted, chips scattering. Model weight files fly everywhere like playing cards: depict them as chunky cream file-sheet tiles and cards bearing ONLY abstract node-and-connection diagrams or simple geometric tensor grids, absolutely no text or typographic symbols. On the other side, suited corporate executives leap back in exaggerated comic shock, their ties and briefcases flying. An obviously drawn chalk moat on the floor, a broad looping chalk outline surrounding the executives' side, is visibly being erased by one developer's sweeping sneaker, with broken chalk lines, smeared chalk dust, and a clear wiped gap. Strong readable visual storytelling, dynamic table diagonal, expressive cartoon pixel characters, rich casino room details, orange and cream highlights, balanced busy composition with clear silhouettes. FULLY OPAQUE background: warm grey and cream floor plus teal/navy room surfaces fill the entire rectangular canvas edge to edge. No transparency, no cutouts, no empty or black corners, no vignette, no letterbox borders. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks anywhere, including on clothes, cards, files, casino fixtures, or objects. No card ranks or suit glyphs that look like typography.
